purpose: The Refund Service allows merchants and support agents to request, approve, track and cancel refunds of card payments.

components.name: Refunds Gateway
components.evidence: The Refunds Gateway receives refund requests and approvals from merchant backends and support agents and passes them to refund-core.

components.name: refund-core
components.evidence: refund-core holds the lifecycle of a refund, stores the refund records with the references of the payments in refund-db (PostgreSQL) and publishes status events to refund-events (Kafka).

components.name: refund-db
components.evidence: refund-core stores the refund records with the references of the payments in refund-db (PostgreSQL).
